skill.name: Semantic Convention Attribute Mapping
skill.description: Reference schema for mapping agent, tool, workflow, and core execution attributes to OpenTelemetry semantic conventions. Defines standardized attribute names and span kinds for consistent span instrumentation across tracing systems.
skill.skill_body:
Use this reference to ensure all instrumented spans employ standardized semantic attribute names from OpenTelemetry conventions. Map execution context (agent state, tool invocation, workflow progress, core operations) to the corresponding AgentAttributes, ToolAttributes, WorkflowAttributes, CoreAttributes, and SpanAttributes classes. Verify span kind assignment (SpanKind) matches the operation type.

## Objective

Provide standardized semantic attribute schema for span instrumentation
## Applicable Signals

- Adding attributes to spans
- Defining span semantics
- Ensuring OpenTelemetry standard compliance
- Instrumenting agent, tool, workflow, or core operation spans

## Contraindications

- Using non-standard or proprietary attribute naming schemes
- When semantic conventions are not required or explicitly disabled
- In systems that do not support OpenTelemetry tracing

## Constraints

- Attribute names must match OpenTelemetry semantic convention definitions
- SpanKind assignment must align with operation type
- All four attribute classes (Agent, Tool, Workflow, Core) should be consulted for completeness

## Output Contract

- Consistent, standards-compliant attribute naming across all instrumented spans
- All span attributes conform to AgentAttributes, ToolAttributes, WorkflowAttributes, CoreAttributes, and SpanAttributes schemas
